hulls.name: F-302
hulls.description: Nimble starter fighter: big swept wings, twin main engines and two nacelles. Tiny cargo hold.

hulls.name: Death Glider
hulls.description: Jaffa attack fighter: a slender pod between great crescent wings that curve forward. Fast, fragile, almost no hold.

hulls.name: Puddle Jumper
hulls.description: Lantean gateship: boxy hull, D-shaped windscreen and drive pods on both flanks. Small enough for the Stargate.

hulls.name: X-303
hulls.description: First Earth battlecruiser: U-shaped engineering section, long neck and a squared bow.

hulls.name: Al'kesh
hulls.description: Mid-range bomber: arrowhead hull with a raised dorsal wedge and four engines aft. Sturdy, with a slow hyperdrive.

hulls.name: X-304
hulls.description: Deep-space battlecruiser: long forward hull, wide engineering section and twin hangar pods.

hulls.name: Ha'tak
hulls.description: Pyramid warship with six great legs. Huge hold, tough and shielded, slow to turn.

hulls.name: Asgard
hulls.description: Pinnacle of Asgard engineering: pointed head, slender neck and vast crescent wings.

hulls.name: Aurora
hulls.description: Lantean battleship: pointed bow, blocky drone module and broad rear wings. Fastest drive, ten mounts.

modules.name: Minigun turret
modules.description: Rapid-fire turret. Aims at the cursor, or auto-targets with a targeting computer.

modules.name: Staff cannon
modules.description: Goa'uld plasma cannon. Slow, heavy energy bolts that splash on impact.

modules.name: Asgard ion beam
modules.description: Instant-hit energy beam that carves through rock. Fires in bursts, then recharges.

modules.name: Missile pod
modules.description: Fires explosive missiles (F / right click). Home in on targets with a targeting computer.

modules.name: Drone launcher
modules.description: Ancient drone weapons (F / right click). Fires a salvo of five self-guided drones in a row; each detonates in a big energy blast.

modules.name: Shield emitter
modules.description: Energy shield absorbs impacts and recharges when not hit.

modules.name: Targeting computer
modules.description: Turrets lock on and fire automatically (toggle with G). Missiles become homing.

modules.name: Hyperdrive
modules.description: Opens a hyperspace window to travel between star systems (starmap, M). Needs a ship of at least cruiser size: fighters must use the Stargate.

modules.name: Ore scanner
modules.description: Scans asteroids for metals: colours the scanner map by ore, pings the area and guides you to the richest asteroid nearby.

modules.name: Ore tractor
modules.description: Tractor beam that pulls in floating ore from further away.

modules.name: Trinium armor
modules.description: Reinforced plating. More hull, a little more mass.

systems.name: Lantea
systems.description: Ocean world of Atlantis. Shipyard and ore market.

systems.name: Earth
systems.description: Home of the SGC. Iron and copper rich belts.

systems.name: Abydos
systems.description: Desert world with naquadah mines. Rich in naquadah.

systems.name: Chulak
systems.description: Jaffa homeworld under Apophis. Titanium-heavy asteroids.

systems.name: Langara
systems.description: Industrial world of Kelowna. Dense, metal-rich fields.

systems.name: Othala
systems.description: Asgard homeworld, far from the Milky Way. Pristine titanium and gold.
